source: Swaters et al. 2002 WHISP-I full atlas; Wayback capture 2007-08-24
interpretation_rule: Native-path signal is a page-level viability flag only; it does not prove the radial H I curve itself is vector. A second parser must isolate the bottom-left profile-panel path and establish axes before any numerical profile is accepted.
boundary: PostScript is parsed as bytes/text only and is never executed. No raster digitization, profile-value extraction, helium factor, frozen-distance conversion, persistence fitting, or blind-outcome inspection.
